meta.title: About Tagly
meta.description: Tagly is an app where local businesses pay real customers for sharing them on Instagram. We're a small team in Prague building marketing that actually works.

hero.title: About Tagly
hero.p1: Tagly started with a simple idea: the best marketing for a business is real people sharing it. So we built an app where businesses pay regular people for their reach, and people earn from their posts.
hero.p2: We're a small team based in Prague. We work on the app every day, and we read everything you send us.
